rules.rule: Treat architecture, ADR, specification, governance, project-state, and website documentation as reviewable repository authority rather than prose noise. Check for contradictions, stale authority, duplicated normative text, accidental promotion of historical/experimental evidence, terminology drift, broken cross-file references, and claims that are not supported by code or executable evidence. For Qianqian playback work, preserve the explicit separation between Composition, Execution/Control, Fact, and Realtime Data planes; do not silently re-freeze reopened playback nouns or let projections/mechanism evidence become semantic authority. Prefer the smallest correction that restores one coherent source of truth.

Review Rust tests as executable semantic evidence. Check whether the test really proves the claimed invariant, whether it can pass vacuously, whether timing/concurrency assumptions are stable, and whether the test accidentally turns experimental playback behavior into architecture authority.
